prompt: Write 10 distinct notes the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual made about one member each while helping them with: a declined claim the member disputes. Each says what will help the next time this agent serves this member: how they like to be dealt with, what is still open, what to check. One or two sentences, third person, no names. This batch leans towards younger members renting or buying their first home. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"preference","content":"Prefers concise explanations and a clear written summary after a phone call; reassures more readily when the next step is set out plainly and in order."},{"type":"fact","content":"The claim remains disputed following a decline for accidental damage, and the member wants the decision reviewed against the policy wording and evidence already supplied."},{"type":"observation","content":"Seems to respond best when the agent acknowledges frustration first, then explains the cover position without jargon or lengthy policy references."},{"type":"preference","content":"Likes messages by text or email rather than repeated calls, and is more comfortable replying in writing when the issue is about proof of ownership or photos."},{"type":"fact","content":"What is still open is confirmation of the loss date, a check on whether the item was within the insured contents limit, and whether the excess was applied correctly."},{"type":"observation","content":"Likely to need extra reassurance around what counts as wear and tear versus a covered sudden event, as the initial disagreement centred on that distinction."},{"type":"preference","content":"Responds well to a calm, practical tone and appreciates being told exactly which documents are missing, rather than being asked to resend everything."},{"type":"fact","content":"The next review should check whether the mobile home alarm or tenancy conditions affect the decision, as the member is renting and may not have provided full supporting evidence."},{"type":"observation","content":"Appears to have little experience with insurance claims and may need the process broken into small steps, especially if escalation to complaints is discussed."},{"type":"fact","content":"If the member contacts again, check the original incident description, any repair estimate, and whether any exclusion for gradual damage was correctly applied before confirming the decline."}]}
